correctness.rationale: Lucas difference and duplication identities give companion parity valuations h and 1, hence exact index valuation-distance identities; three normalized maps are isometries of N0 and their reductions are permutations of every dyadic quotient. This proves all three full balls and exact count. Separate finite checker passed 132 images and 25,308 index-distance comparisons.

originality.rationale: Inspected primary 2020, 2023 and 2022 papers and general residue-count work from 2021 and 2024, compared reciprocal/plus sign conventions and full-coverage strength. The most relevant discriminator theorem covers the other trace congruence and does not determine the three balls; current available earlier records likewise do not state this complete fixed-sequence image. Prior implicit derivations remain possible.
residual_risks: An older specialized modular-image theorem for Chebyshev/Lucas sequences in equivalent notation may implicitly yield the result.
The 2020 paper gives a nearby complete-permutation theorem; some familiar proof techniques may shorten this result substantially.

value.rationale: Sharp dyadic boundary problem motivated by the studied complete-residue case at P≡2 mod4. For every excluded 4-divisible trace the full image, every finite residue-set size, normalized isometric index parametrizations, and limiting density are determined. This is a natural infinite-family completion with exact topology, not a routine finite observation.
